body:
If you’re interested in catching Brian McLaren’s Learning How to See podcast, you’ll find new episodes here: https://cac.org/podcast/learning-how-to-see/

 If you’re interested in Brian’s appearances on other podcasts, just search for “Brian McLaren podcast” or “Brian McLaren spotify,” or something similar, and you’ll find lots of options.

 Finally, if you are a podcaster and would like to invite Brian to appear on your podcast, he will be taking a break from scheduling additional podcast appearances at least through August to focus on his next writing project. Thanks for understanding.
